messages.text:
Good rate — that's the cheap end, which makes the 40T a fun one to run. It's $799, and at under 12¢ you're drawing for a full block every ten minutes while stacking sats meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
adding to setup and i pay 4 cents per kWh

At 4 cents you're in rare territory — the 40T actually nets positive.

It stacks about 57,200 sats a month, roughly $47.66 at today's price, against $18.97 of power. Break-even BTC price is $33,160, so you've got a wide margin. Plus a 3.136 BTC block draw every ten minutes — about 0.22% odds over a year.

$799, ships November 14, 2026. Want me to build the cart?
will there be another batch after this one?

Nothing announced past Batch 5. What I can tell you is the price has gone up each rung — Wave 1 was $649, then $749, now $799 — so a later batch wouldn't be cheaper.

Batch 5 is 50 units, and Batch 3 sold out in 25 minutes. I'd take the $799 rather than wait on a batch that may not open.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
